recipe.calibration_note: Limits inherited from this design; choose a sand recipe to replace them

manufacturing.bench_notes: Procedural half-round keyed to a fat-tail swell, poured in lost wax. The Gila's beadwork: full round beads in the black bands, flattened pebbles in the salmon ground, the dorsal row a size up on the crest, and a 3 mm spessartite in a collet on the swell's mound. At the bench: burnish the collet's lip over the stone; polish the bead tops, leave the lands satin.
